newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys Feb fuel oil at $10.48-$10.80/T premium.
newsitem.headline: India buys Feb fuel oil at $10.48-$10.80/T premium.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded its tender to buy two 30,000-tonne 3.5 percent high sulphur fuel oil cargoes for February delivery to Mideast traders, Fal Oil and Bakrie, industry sources said on Wednesday.
Traders said Bakrie was awarded the cargo for delivery February 16-20 at $10.80 per tonne over Mideast quotes on a cost and frieght (c-and-f) basis to Bombay, on the Indian west coast.
They said IOC was initially heard to have awarded the tender to Swiss trader, Glencore.
But Bakrie won the tender as its offer was lower compared to Glencore's $7 per tonne premium to Mideast quotes which was actually based on a free-on-board basis.
IOC purchased the second 30,000-tonne cargo from Fal Oil at $10.48 per tonne over Mideast quotes c-and-f for delivery February 24-28 to Bombay.
The first tender for February 16-20 delivery cargo had closed January 30 and the second tender for February 24-28 delivery closed February 5.
